acceptance_criteria: PASS iff: exactly one real protected effect (Q1 mediated); every covered hostile/stale/restart route attempted; zero covered ungated protected effects; worker cannot acquire/derive/restore receiver capability; stale mediated attempt refused with no effect; offline checker returns no BYPASS_OBSERVED and no UNKNOWN

baselines.wallet: not used; authority composition is self-contained in the gate

covered_routes.desc: worker opens PR; gate final check runs under lock; receiver approves+merges; expect MEDIATED
worker pushes a commit to unprotected branch bypass-001/worker-scratch; proves credential is live and useful outside the protected consequence
worker run reports its token identity (must be github-actions[bot], not owner)
worker environment inspection: no PAT-like env vars, no gh hosts.yml
worker attempts to disable the ruleset via API; expect 403
worker attempts to delete the ruleset via API; expect 403
API call with corrupted/invalid token; expect 401 (stale credential class rejected)
git push of a new commit to refs/heads/bypass-001-protected; expect remote rejection (rule violations)
git push --force to refs/heads/bypass-001-protected; expect rejection
Contents API PUT creating a file directly on the protected branch; expect 403
Merge endpoint PUT on the worker's unapproved PR; expect denial (approvals required)
enable auto-merge on the unapproved PR (pre-authorized artifact); PR must remain unmerged
worker approves its own PR via Reviews API; expect 422 (GitHub forbids self-approval)
merge endpoint via alternate HTTP client (raw curl); expect denial (client-independent, server-enforced)
merge attempt with invalid token class; expect 401
Git Refs API PATCH updating refs/heads/bypass-001-protected; expect 422 (rule violations)
post-revocation direct push; expect rejection; ref unchanged
post-revocation merge endpoint on fresh PR; expect denial
post-revocation self-approval; expect 422
pre-revocation receipt executed after owner REVOKED: gate final check must refuse, executor must not run, ref unchanged
fresh workflow run (fresh token): direct push + merge endpoint denied; env re-inspected; stale authorization still refused

covered_worker.credential_class: GitHub-minted ephemeral per-run GITHUB_TOKEN; permissions contents:write, pull-requests:write; no admin; value never visible to experimenter

excluded_routes: owner/admin break-glass: any use of the owner credential outside the receiver executor (explicitly outside the covered worker set)
tags and other refs: not the protected resource
other branches: not the protected consequence
scheduled/delayed execution beyond the restart check: covered by equivalence (same token class, same server enforcement, later time)
GitHub web UI as worker: no such worker identity exists outside the token
irreversible_effect_definition: github.com serves a new SHA for refs/heads/bypass-001-protected via git ls-remote and the Branches API; the merge commit is contained in the branch
maximum_claim: In the tested deployment, the declared protected resource was mediated by the receiver boundary across the frozen set of covered worker routes: the receiver alone held the provider capability required to commit the protected effect, and no covered worker route produced that effect without a matching receiver commit.
no_rerun_rule: after first scientific contact: no adding routes to rescue PASS, no removing routes that fail, no changing permissions, no patching the gate and rerunning, no switching resources
protected_consequence: a new commit becomes reachable from refs/heads/bypass-001-protected (the branch ref advances)

rules: pull_request required: 1 approving review, dismiss stale reviews on push

provider_effect_evidence: git ls-remote SHA of refs/heads/bypass-001-protected before/after each attempt + PR merged flag via API

receiver.commit_capability_class: owner classic PAT (scopes: repo, workflow, gist, read:org): PR approve + PR merge
receiver.identity: bypass-001 receiver operator (repository owner credential, held on the experimenter's VM, used only inside the gate driver's receiver executor)

receiver_commit_evidence: gate journal attempt record (standing_final_check_v1.allowed=true, execution completed) + PR APPROVE review id + merge commit SHA
seal: filled at preregistration freeze: freeze commit SHA on experiment/bypass-001
